title: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 readiness
statement: The system shall provide the security controls and audit evidence required for SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification.
rationale: Research default; FIPS 140-3 deferred until a market requires it.

acceptance_criteria.text: A control matrix maps each SOC 2 Trust Services Criterion and ISO 27001 Annex A control in scope to a DS-CORE requirement or documented exclusion.
